user.title: Choose data sources
user.description: This experimental read-only integration is under development. Local eManager and Elekeeper Open Platform are separate future data sources. No SAJ communication is performed in this alpha version.

open_platform.title: Elekeeper Open Platform
open_platform.description: Enter the approved App ID and App Secret. They are stored in the Home Assistant config entry and excluded from diagnostics. Credential verification and API communication are not implemented in this alpha version.

local_emanager.title: Local eManager placeholder
local_emanager.description: The confirmed local architecture uses eManager/BSaj. The exact read-only transport request is not sufficiently confirmed, so this alpha asks for no host, port, unit ID or other connection details. Submit to create a placeholder entry.

error.source_required: Select at least one future data source.
